promote_guide.merge_mode: auto — orchestrator (D-053) rebases+merges feature branch into dev after all gates pass
promote_guide.no_migrations: T-0187 adds no SQL migrations, no DDL changes, no known_tenant_tables.txt changes. Pure package.json + new ci/checks shell script.
promote_guide.IMPORTANT_rebase_conflict_rule: package.json WILL conflict when rebasing against any sibling branch that added fitness entries using the old duplicate-key pattern. The only correct resolution is: produce EXACTLY ONE 'fitness' key containing the UNION of all commands from both sides. After resolution, bash ci/checks/package-json-no-dup-keys.sh MUST exit 0. The old pattern of 'append to the tail of the last key' is no longer valid — there is now only one key.
promote_guide.guard_canary: ci/checks/package-json-no-dup-keys.sh is the post-merge canary. Any surviving duplicate key causes npm run fitness to fail immediately on the first entry.
promote_guide.downstream_effect: After this merge, all 96 fitness checks run on every CI invocation. named-binding-isolation.sh (T-0072 invariants) and npm run build (tsc compile check) are now structurally enforced again. Sibling tasks that previously escaped named-binding or build regressions will now be caught in fitness.
